LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentAlreadyPresent: A Trident battle or surviving test troops are still on this map. Use Clear Trident test troops before starting another.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentNoSpace: Choose the center of a large, revealed clearing, roughly 60 cells wide and 25 cells tall. Each formation needs 100 free, walkable cells connected to the center, away from buildings, fire, and other pawns.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentMissingFaction: Battle canceled: {0} is absent or defeated in this world. No troops were spawned.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentBadRoster: Battle canceled: {0} has no valid combat roster for this test. No troops were spawned.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentStarted: Battle of the trident: 100 versus 100 ready. West: 34 Valyria, 33 Westerlanders, 33 Reachmen. East: 25 Riverlanders, 25 Northmen, 25 Valemen, 25 Stormlanders. Unpause to begin; press Esc to leave the placement tool. Normal faction diplomacy is unchanged. Keep colonists away from stray arrows.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentFinished: Battle of the trident finished. Standing side: {0}. Mobile survivors will leave the map. Downed soldiers, bodies, dropped equipment, and battle damage remain.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentFailed: Trident battle generation failed. Generated test troops were cleared; see the debug log for the cause.
LanguageData.ARIOIAF_TridentCleared: Trident test troops and their bodies on this map were cleared. Recruited colonists, colony prisoners, departed pawns, dropped loot, and battle damage were left untouched.
